primary_focus: Script content audit (UC-20): every SoftDist run of a .ps1/.bat/.cmd/.vbs/.py payload (and bundle entry_point scripts) writes a tamper-evident transcript to <SKVC>\logs\softdist\<action_id>.transcript BEFORE execution. Default record is SHA-256 + size + first/last 500 bytes. Signed per-task flag SoftwareDeploySpec.capture_script_content opts into FULL content capture; endpoint policy AEGIS_LOG_SCRIPT_CONTENT (enabled|disabled|always) overrides the signed flag (kill switch for regulated endpoints, force-on for forensic endpoints). SecureParameters NEVER appear in the transcript — scripts are read verbatim from disk before any ${name} substitution. Audit read / transcript write failures fail the deploy loud (phase FAILED) — never run unaudited. BigFix parity goal met: BigFix client logs show the script filename but not content; Aegis One now surfaces content with policy control.
